title: COVI-AgentSim: an Agent-based Model for Evaluating Methods of Digital Contact Tracing
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and socio-economic evaluation of digital contact tracing methods using an agent-based model. It evaluates strategies based on metrics like Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) and Temporary Productivity Loss (TPL). While it touches upon public health choices, it does not engage in a primary evaluation or benchmarking of morals or ethics beyond a brief mention of 'ethical considerations' in the limitations section, which does not constitute a core component of the research as per the instructions.
